text:
In the first scene, I feel a subtle sense of anticipation, standing before a clean, modern glass enclosure—perhaps a space reserved for innovation or communal gatherings. Inside, order and quietude prevail, yet I am separated from it by a transparent barrier. There is a slight disorientation, enhanced by the angle, as if the world tilts just enough to remind me everything is in flux.

In the second scene, vibrant colors and bold lettering invite me to immerse myself in the world of research and development. Surrounded by information and visual stimuli, I sense curiosity awakening—a desire to learn and connect. Here, I feel energized and inspired by the possibilities of creativity and progress, my mind drawn outward into dialogue with the fabric of innovation itself.
